_doc: Regional Economy & Trade (design/gdd/regional-economy-trade.md) and the money holders of its Formula H. Values marked guess in the GDD are guesses here too; the economy harness tunes them.

money._doc: Formula H and J. reserve_by_realm: what an NPC keeps, 2 x the realm's mission pay (Sects F12: 10 x 1 / 8 / 60 / 400 / 3,000). An NPC's starting purse is its reserve x a keyed draw in purse_start (world generation; WorldBuilder._step_money). Each great sect's market starts with a commons pool of pool_start and an empty lost-stash pool. stipend: Sects' cash stipend a season by realm before the kind share (kind_stipend). mission_base x mission_scale: Sects F12's mission pay by realm. tf0 + tf_step x Tax: Sects F3's market tax rate. npc_rate_ref: an NPC's reference cultivation rate by realm (tu vi a season), from Formula J's output range (15 / 70 / 2,000 / 57,000 / 1.2M stones at the cap = 0.5 x rate x spt); NPCs have no rate of their own, so their stones and baskets speed their stage chance by (1 + prov) x (1 + stone_boost) (user decision 2026-11-20: money speeds NPCs). stash_mine_share: the share of every mine's output that goes to its market's lost-stash pool (losses, theft, buried caches), from which explore finds, caches and discovery loot are drawn (Formula K; user decision 2026-11-20: the design's wild-site share alone left the stash empty on continent 11, where every mine has a holder).

classes._doc: Per raw kind (rule 4; a rarity band takes its kind's values). Formulas C-E. The pill, talisman and artifact rows are Trade Goods Formula E's crafted parameters.

demand._doc: Formula C and L2. basket by realm in base value, pegged to the stipends.

links._doc: Formula F. tariff by Openness 1-4 (0: no link). enabled: the flows between markets run (off only to isolate a market in a probe).

shop._doc: Formula G. bm/sr raw = the bulk spread; finished keep the built retail spread. Margins by place kind.

goods._doc: Trade Goods (design/gdd/trade-goods.md Formulas B, C, D; TradeGoods). dust: below this fraction of a unit a good with no inflow is dropped from a pool. sigma, eta, wsh_min: the scarcity factor's softening, strength and world-share floor. theta_s, n_spec: a specialty's bar (a share of the top region's output) and most regions. Guesses.

shelf._doc: Regional Economy & Trade Edge Cases (restock) and AC-RE-35, Trade Goods rules 8 and 10 (user decision 2026-11-20: shops are a view of the pool, herbs at mature age only): each season a market place's shelf lists the shelved goods of its market's raw pools, each at the place's share of the pool by settlement weight; herb_max and material_max cap the items listed per good (a view, not a withdrawal).

crafted._doc: Trade Goods Formulas E-H (CraftEconomy): pill classes by tier (Item Database pill_band_edges), with the pill row of classes' price and stock parameters. v_lo: each tier's demand floor (about one item). tp_by_realm: the pill tier each realm's basket buys. Craft plan: kappa (answer to price over input cost), lambda (to cover), c_lo, alpha_p (inertia), delta_p (largest move), phi_p (floor as a share of the plan at rest), fill_tol (no windup below it). ps: workshop success. Guesses.
